568:t_3:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm kidding. You're still a kid in that respect.」

568:t_3:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「Yeah, yeah! $$シンジ$$ and $$ニコラ$$ are growing from boys into men!」

568:t_3:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「If you ever need help, turn to us. We've got more life experience.」

568:t_3:19.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just so you know, $$赤木$$... I plan to grow up, but I have no intention of becoming an old geezer.」

568:t_3:21.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'll grow up... I'll move toward the future...)

568:t_3:22.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Do I have one, too...? A future...?)

568:t_3:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We can leave $$ニコラ$$ and $$シンジ$$ to $$赤木$$.」

568:t_3:24.en:
$$青山$$
「Boys who want to grow up seem to get along well with adults who never quite grew up.」

568:t_3:25.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Still, for $$シンジ$$'s wish to transport $c...」

568:t_3:26.en:
$$桂$$
「The situation was completely out of control.」

568:t_3:27.en:
$$桂$$
「The feeling of everyone's wishes swirling together was like repairing space-time during the $$多元戦争$$, but the chaos was on another level.」

568:t_3:28.en:
$$万丈$$
「The distortion in the dimensional boundary seems to have settled for now, but we don't know what might happen next, or when.」

568:t_3:29.en:
$$青山$$
「Worst case, a whole swarm of $$バアル$$ could come out of that hole?」

568:t_3:30.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Space-time itself could collapse before that.」

568:t_3:31.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The three keys... It seems Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$ wasn't the third $$特異点$$.」

568:t_3:32.en:
$$オルソン$$
「She was a $$特異点$$ of the $$ウィスパード$$ phenomenon, but now that her abilities are gone, we should assume the key $$サイデリアル$$ mentioned is someone else.」

568:t_3:34.en:
$$桂$$
(Thanks to $$レナード$$ seeing me as an enemy, I'm starting to see who the third one is...)

568:t_3:38.en:
$$桂$$
(If it's that person, we'll need to be careful. Anyone from that group must be pretty twisted...)

568:t_3:39.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The search for the three keys... Are we back to square one...?」

568:t_3:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then the quickest way would be to ask the source of that information directly.」

568:t_3:42.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Our arrival on $$蒼の地球$$ made each of the three Reactors act. That has gradually thinned their front lines in various regions.」

568:t_3:43.en:
$$万丈$$
「Preparations for the counteroffensive will have advanced in the meantime, too.」

568:t_3:44.en:
$$桂$$
「So now we just have to find the right moment to go.」

568:t_3:45.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That black $$アンゲロイ$$ might show up there, too...」

568:t_3:46.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's a good opportunity. I'd like to finally clarify the connection between the fundamental calamity and $$サイデリアル$$.」

568:t_3:47.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But there's something we have to settle before that.」

568:t_3:49.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Their strength has declined with $$ハマーン・カーン$$ and $$ザフト$$ leaving them. They may try a desperate move to turn things around.」

568:t_3:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That battle will probably center on $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

568:t_3:51.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Something powerful enough to overthrow the $$地球連邦$$...」

568:t_3:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If it falls into $$フル・フロンタル$$'s hands, he's cunning enough to use it to undermine forces opposing the Empire across the world.」

568:t_3:53.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's the last thing we want at this stage.」

568:t_3:54.en:
$$桂$$
「I hate it... That gentleman always comes at us with such practical schemes.」

568:t_3:55.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That's what sets him apart from Colonel $$シャア$$, who's full of romantic ideals.」

568:t_3:56.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Though I don't understand men's romantic ideals myself.」

568:t_3:57.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you're just like $$ハマーン・カーン$$.」

568:t_3:58.en:
$$いぶき$$
「But the way she forgives the Colonel for it shows even the Iron Lady is still a woman.」

568:t_3:59.en:
$$青山$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ is a realist through and through. He'll make one last move.」

568:t_3:60.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I hear $c will resupply aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ to meet that attack.」

568:t_3:61.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So that'll be the site of our final battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...」

568:t_3:62.en:
$$桂$$
「The fight over $$ラプラスの箱$$ that began in the $$時獄戦役$$ is finally reaching its climax.」

568:t_3:63.en:
$$青山$$
「Maybe it's inappropriate, but now that we've come this far, I'm curious what's inside the Box.」

568:t_3:64.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We should leave the decision to reveal its contents to those entrusted with it.」

568:t_3:65.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$バナージ$$ and Princess $$ミネバ$$.」

568:t_3:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like to believe they'll use that power to lead us into the future...」

568:t_3:70.en: ～$$ネオ・ジオン$$ Leader's　Private Quarters～

568:t_3:71.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Since you told me the truth, does that mean you acknowledge me as humanity's successor?」

568:t_3:72.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That depends on what you do from now on.」

568:t_3:73.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I understand. Then I will seal the Box by my own power.」

568:t_3:74.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To save humanity from despair.」

568:t_3:75.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be looking forward to it.」

568:t_3:78.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I suppose that is humanity's limit...」

568:t_3:79.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(That's how it is, $$シャア・アズナブル$$... And you, $$バナージ$$...)

568:t_3:80.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(The battle to decide our future... and humanity's, too, seems to be drawing to a close.)

568:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. The owner, $$ＡＧ$$, is absent today, so $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will operate under our caretaker service.」

568:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that our congratulations to ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion.」

568:t_10:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'd heard he was such an amusing fellow, so I was looking forward to meeting him. What a pity.」

568:t_10:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then, Big Sis, I'll do that...!」

568:t_10:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's give it our aaaall today!」

568:t_10:14.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「$$オオタ・カズミ$$... Your registration is complete.」

568:t_10:16.en:
$n
(Don't tell me... you got caught in the $$時空震動$$...?)

569:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I've confirmed all $c ships and mobile units. Everyone is safe.」

569:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So everyone who was there was sent to this red land.」

569:t_000:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「We've received word from $$アスカ$$. The EVA pilots are all in one place.」

569:t_000:3.en:
$$ラム$$
「She also says this is their world.」
